mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 315.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) combined with declining payroll employment (PAYEMS decline > 50k in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profit growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for the interaction remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
